text:
1. 5. 5. 

Seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado āvilo lulito kalalībhūto, tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito na passeyya sippisambukampi sakkharakaṭhalampi macchagumbampi carantampi tiṭṭhantamapi. Taṃ kissa hetu: āvilattā bhikkhave udakassa. Evameva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu āvilena cittena attatthaṃ vā ñassati, paratthaṃ vā ñassati, ubhayatthaṃ vā ñassati, uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikarissatīti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Taṃ kissa hetu: āvilattā bhikkhave cittassāti.37
